QF.id: AIFM CIII Legal Documents and Negotiations_5

question.text: Mr. Ramesh Iyer is subscribing INR 5 crore to Kaveri Macro Fund (Cat III, trust-form). Which parties execute the Contribution (Subscription) Agreement for his participation?

answer.text: Mr. Iyer (contributor), the Trustee and the Investment Manager.
Only Mr. Iyer and the Investment Manager.
Mr. Iyer, the Custodian and the Merchant Banker.
Mr. Iyer, SEBI and the Sponsor.

explanation.text: The Logic: Chapter 9.4 states the Contribution Agreement 'is to be entered into by and between each contributor (i.e. investor), the trustee and the investment manager.' The Trustee holds the trust property and the Manager handles investment; both are necessary counterparties with the investor. The Trap: Option B drops the Trustee — a common mistake because operationally the Manager interacts with the investor. Option C swaps in service providers who are NOT parties to the contribution agreement. Option D mistakenly includes SEBI (a regulator, not a party). Cross-Exam Context: XIX-C tests the same tri-party structure. XIX-B (Cat III Distributor) focuses on subscription disclosures to clients; XIX-A emphasises commitment drawdowns (Cat I/II). XXI-B Portfolio Managers have a bilateral PM-client agreement — different model. Manager's Pro-Tip: On a Cat III desk, issue units in DEMAT mode only (SEBI circular June 21, 2023) and reference the DP details in the Subscription Agreement schedule — this also enables clean side-pocket unit-class creation when needed.
